metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the enemy just walked into my bullet by accident
metadata.description:
Didn't even mean to shoot but hey, 1 unlucky soul got clipped.
Enemy probably uninstalling to rethink their life.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still gives out freebies.
Watch me pretend this was pure skill for a sec.

Tap if your aim was out but the game still said yes!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
